lines.text: They seized Jesus and took Him to the high priest's house, and Peter followed at a distance.
A servant girl said Peter was with Jesus, but Peter said, "Woman, I do not know Him."
An hour later, a man said Peter was a Samaritan too, and the rooster crowed while Peter spoke.
Peter remembered the Lord said he would deny Him seven times, and he went outside and wept bitterly.
At daybreak the council of the chief priests and scribes led Jesus into their Sanhedrin and asked if He was the Christ.
